tags.name: 3PM from a big
tags.meaning: A forward or center who makes many threes for his position, which helps builds that want threes from the frontcourt.

tags.name: 3PM specialist
tags.meaning: Threes made are a real outlier: far above the top 250 pool.

tags.name: AST from a big
tags.meaning: A forward or center with guard-like assists. Rare, so it helps builds that need assists from the frontcourt.

tags.name: AST specialist
tags.meaning: Assists are a real outlier: far above the top 250 pool.

tags.name: BLK specialist
tags.meaning: Blocks are a real outlier: far above the top 250 pool.

tags.name: elite per game
tags.meaning: Per game line near the top of the league; his value question is games played, not quality.

tags.name: FG% anchor
tags.meaning: High FG% on high volume. Lifts a team's FG% clearly.

tags.name: FG% liability
tags.meaning: Low FG% on real volume. Hurts a team's FG% clearly.

tags.name: FT% anchor
tags.meaning: High FT% on high volume. Lifts a team's FT% clearly.

tags.name: FT% liability
tags.meaning: Low FT% on real volume. Hurts a team's FT% clearly; often the reason to punt FT%.

tags.name: high TO
tags.meaning: Many turnovers. Hurts the TO category.

tags.name: low TO
tags.meaning: Few turnovers for his role.

tags.name: no 3PM
tags.meaning: Makes almost no threes.

tags.name: PTS specialist
tags.meaning: Points are a real outlier: far above the top 250 pool, not just a good scorer.

tags.name: REB specialist
tags.meaning: Rebounds are a real outlier: far above the top 250 pool.

tags.name: STL specialist
tags.meaning: Steals are a real outlier: far above the top 250 pool.

tags.name: fits every build
tags.meaning: No weak category, so he helps any punt build.

tags.name: Giannis build fit
tags.meaning: Fits next to Giannis Antetokounmpo in a punt FT% build (Lloyd's build rule).

tags.name: punt 3PM fit
tags.meaning: Weak in threes for his position, so a punt 3PM team loses little with him.

tags.name: punt AST fit
tags.meaning: Weak in assists for his position, so a punt AST team loses little with him.

tags.name: punt BLK fit
tags.meaning: Weak in blocks for his position (not just a guard with few blocks), so a punt BLK team loses little with him.

tags.name: punt FG fit
tags.meaning: Weak in FG% for his position, so a punt FG% team loses little with him.

tags.name: punt FT fit
tags.meaning: Weak in FT% for his position, so a punt FT% team loses little with him.

tags.name: punt PTS fit
tags.meaning: Weak in points for his position, so a punt PTS team loses little with him.

tags.name: punt REB fit
tags.meaning: Weak in rebounds for his position, so a punt REB team loses little with him.

tags.name: punt STL fit
tags.meaning: Weak in steals for his position, so a punt STL team loses little with him.

tags.name: punt TO fit
tags.meaning: Many turnovers for his position, so a punt TO team loses little with him.

tags.name: contract year
tags.meaning: In the last year of his contract, so a new deal and a bigger role are at stake this season.

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.meaning: Another player competes for the same minutes; his role is not clear yet.

tags.name: minutes limit
tags.meaning: His team or coach holds his minutes below a full starter's load on purpose, even when he is healthy.

tags.name: needs playmaker
tags.meaning: Not a self-creator. His efficiency depends on a playmaker on the floor with him.

tags.name: new team
tags.meaning: Changed NBA team since last season.

tags.name: role down
tags.meaning: Expected to get fewer minutes, less usage or a smaller role than last season.

tags.name: role up
tags.meaning: Expected to get more minutes, usage or a bigger role than last season.

tags.name: rookie
tags.meaning: First NBA season.

tags.name: two-way contract
tags.meaning: On a two-way contract, so his NBA games and role are limited until he gets a standard deal.

tags.name: unsigned
tags.meaning: Not on any NBA roster now, so his role and value depend on where he signs.

tags.name: usage competition
tags.meaning: Shares the ball with high-usage teammates, which caps his shots and touches even as a starter.

tags.name: usage dependent
tags.meaning: His fantasy value depends on being a top usage option and drops sharply in a smaller role.

tags.name: bounce-back
tags.meaning: Expected to recover after one bad season (glossary: Bounce-back).

tags.name: breakout
tags.meaning: Expected to produce clearly more than last season (glossary: Breakout).

tags.name: bust candidate
tags.meaning: Expected to return clearly less than his draft price. Detail names the site or price when the call is about one site.

tags.name: early-season value
tags.meaning: Expected to produce most early in the season, with value likely to fade later.

tags.name: flyer
tags.meaning: Cheap late pick with high upside, easy to replace if he fails.

tags.name: handcuff
tags.meaning: A backup with real value when the starter ahead of him is out.

tags.name: IL stash
tags.meaning: Injured now but worth drafting late and holding in an IL slot until he returns.

tags.name: regression risk
tags.meaning: A recent jump in shooting or other rates is expected to come back down.

tags.name: sleeper
tags.meaning: The market prices him low and the expert likes him.

tags.name: slow start
tags.meaning: Expected to be limited or weaker early in the season and to produce clearly more later, by the fantasy playoffs.

tags.name: waiver watch
tags.meaning: Not a draft target in our league, but worth watching on waivers early in the season.

tags.name: age decline watch
tags.meaning: Age makes a drop in minutes or production likely.

tags.name: back-to-back risk
tags.meaning: Expected to sit some back-to-back games this season.

tags.name: consistent
tags.meaning: His game-to-game production varies very little, so his weekly output is reliable.

tags.name: cut candidate
tags.meaning: His NBA team may waive him, so he could lose his roster spot and role.

tags.name: foul prone
tags.meaning: Commits many fouls, which limits his minutes.

tags.name: injury prone
tags.meaning: Expected to miss games from a chronic or repeated injury (Lloyd: repeated injuries or surgery on the same lower-body part).

tags.name: load management
tags.meaning: Rests on purpose when healthy, often in back-to-backs.

tags.name: off-court risk
tags.meaning: Has off-court problems or past suspensions that can cost games or trust.

tags.name: plays every game
tags.meaning: Record of very few missed games.

tags.name: shutdown risk
tags.meaning: His NBA team may stop playing him late in the season.

tags.name: streaky
tags.meaning: His production or shooting swings between hot and cold stretches, so his weekly output is hard to predict.

tags.name: trade risk
tags.meaning: A trade is possible and could lower his role.

tags.name: injured now
tags.meaning: Has an injury now that can cost games at the start of the season.

tags.name: injury last season
tags.meaning: Missed many games last season, so last season's totals understate him.

tags.name: questionable
tags.meaning: Yahoo status questionable or day to day now.

tags.name: 9-cat fluff
tags.meaning: His 9-cat rank is higher than his real H2H worth (see Nine-cat fluff in the glossary).

tags.name: category league player
tags.meaning: Worth clearly more in 9-cat category leagues than in points leagues, so points-based rankings and ADP underrate him.

tags.name: expert target
tags.meaning: The expert ranks him clearly above the market and wants to draft him.

tags.name: points league player
tags.meaning: Worth clearly more in points leagues than in 9-cat. Rankings from points formats overrate him for us.

tags.name: sites disagree on price
tags.meaning: Yahoo and ESPN prices or ranks differ a lot.

tags.name: undervalued by 9-cat
tags.meaning: Plain 9-cat rankings rate him lower than his real H2H worth.

tags.name: bad playoff schedule
tags.meaning: Few games or many back-to-backs in our fantasy playoff weeks (19 to 21).

tags.name: few back-to-backs
tags.meaning: His team has few back-to-backs this season, so rest risk is lower.

tags.name: good playoff schedule
tags.meaning: Many games or few back-to-backs in our fantasy playoff weeks (19 to 21).

tags.name: many back-to-backs
tags.meaning: The team has many back-to-backs this season, so rest risk for its players is higher.

tags.name: buy low
tags.meaning: Trade for him now; other managers price him below his real value.

tags.name: drop
tags.meaning: Not worth a roster spot now. About the present only.

tags.name: must add
tags.meaning: Free agent the expert says every team should add now.

tags.name: sell high
tags.meaning: Trade him now; other managers price him above his real value.

tags.name: bottom team
tags.meaning: The team is projected to finish near the bottom of the league this season.

tags.name: concentrated usage
tags.meaning: One or a few stars take most of the team's shots and touches, which caps the usage of everyone else.

tags.name: deep rotation
tags.meaning: Many players compete for the team's minutes, so minutes are spread and roles shrink.

tags.name: defense-first
tags.meaning: The team is built around defense, with limited offensive creation and spacing.

tags.name: fast pace
tags.meaning: The team plays at a fast pace, which raises its players' counting stats.

tags.name: five-out offense
tags.meaning: The coach spaces all five players around the arc, so centers and forwards take more threes than usual.

tags.name: heavy starter minutes
tags.meaning: The coach gives his starters heavy minutes, which raises their counting stats and shrinks bench value.

tags.name: low shutdown risk
tags.meaning: The team is not expected to tank, rest healthy players or shut players down late in the season.

tags.name: new coach
tags.meaning: The team has a new head coach this season, so rotation and minutes habits are less predictable.

tags.name: rookie-averse coach
tags.meaning: The coach rarely starts or trusts rookies, which caps rookie roles on this team.

tags.name: shared ball handling
tags.meaning: The team has no single lead ball handler, so assists and usage are spread across several players.

tags.name: stable starters
tags.meaning: The coach rarely changes the starting lineup unless someone is hurt, so starter roles are stable.

tags.name: tank risk
tags.meaning: The team may put draft lottery odds ahead of winning and rest or limit veterans, mostly late in the season.

tags.name: thin rotation
tags.meaning: The team has little depth, so starters carry heavy loads and an injury opens a big role for a reserve.

tags.name: three-point heavy
tags.meaning: The team takes many threes as a style, which lifts 3PM for its shooters.

tags.name: trades likely
tags.meaning: The front office is expected to make trades this season, which can change roles on the team.

tags.name: unsettled rotation
tags.meaning: The team's starters or minutes are not settled or change often, so player roles are hard to predict.

tags.name: usage freed
tags.meaning: The team lost high-usage players, so the remaining players should get more shots and touches.

tags.name: winning team
tags.meaning: The team is projected to win clearly more than half its games and make the playoffs.
